description_en: Retrieves a list of A/B metric groups
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-ab-metric-groups --scene-id 1 --instance-id pairec-cn-test1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --realtime false --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order ASC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListABMetricGroups

parameters.description_en: The scene ID. You can call the [ListScenes](\(~~2402581~~\)) operation to obtain this ID.
parameters.help_en: The scene ID. You can call the [ListScenes](\(~~2402581~~\)) operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: scene_id

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. You can call the [ListInstances](~~2411819~~) operation to obtain this ID.
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to return only real-time A/B metric groups.
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only real-time A/B metric groups
parameters.name: realtime

parameters.description_en:
